name: bkk-rain-stations
description: Bangkok rain gauge network — 133 stations from the Hydro-Informatics Institute (HII) via api-v3.thaiwater.net. Live rain_24h and rain_1h readings, geocoded to the station lat/lon. Steals the BKK provincial station list that powers bangkok.thaiwater.net/dashboard.
attribution: Data: Hydro-Informatics Institute (สสน.) / ThaiWater v3 API · Royal Irrigation Department · Department of Drainage, Bangkok (BMA). Endpoint: api-v3.thaiwater.net/api/v1/thaiwater30/provinces/rain24
